Benin.idiosyncrasy: Distinct seed-crop labels identify line items after input labels become Seed; a historical non-injective map lost rows.

Burkina_Faso.idiosyncrasy: Parcel GPS area is not a geographic coordinate; the2014 module ships area measurements without position.

CotedIvoire.idiosyncrasy: The canonical plot-axis spelling is plot_id; native crop/labor declarations were aligned explicitly.

Ethiopia.idiosyncrasy: ESS parcel attributes broadcast onto field rows through a left join; parcel and field grains differ.

EthiopiaRHS.idiosyncrasy: Coarse household-level crop data lacks plot grain;1989 livestock/income files served at1999 remain a live documented WAITING caveat.

GhanaLSS.idiosyncrasy: GLSS1/2 include a rotating panel; independent cross-sections begin atGLSS3, and household take is per workload rather than perEA.

GhanaSPS.idiosyncrasy: Agricultural service purchases are distinct from crop sales; sales are household-crop grain in2013 and plot-crop in2017.

Guinea-Bissau.idiosyncrasy: One EHCVM2018-19 wave only; no2021-22 wave. Native plots use a field/parcel composite.

Malawi.idiosyncrasy: Historical null-plot rows were lost by groupby dropna; duplicate rows on actual plot identifiers were not the explanation.

Mali.idiosyncrasy: Plot features use two EHCVM parcel waves; some2021 source rows lack real plot identifiers.

Niger.idiosyncrasy: Site1/Site2 identifier grain issues are documented source/config work, including an existing plot_inputs cell.

Nigeria.idiosyncrasy: Some2011 crop units have lost container size; size-agnostic labels can remain unconverted under the existing ladder.

Senegal.idiosyncrasy: Plot identifiers combine field and parcel; area prefers GPS measurement then converted farmer estimate.

Tanzania.idiosyncrasy: 2019 extended-panel and2020 refresh-panel waves are disjoint by design; the closed#114 duplicate-food issue retains a live WAITING entry.

Togo.idiosyncrasy: Distinct seed-crop line items need injective labels after every seed input becomes Seed.

Uganda.idiosyncrasy: Agriculture modules cover a self-selected subset; wave household weights do not describe that subset. Existing crop-value WAITING and null-key/KgFactor TODO caveats remain.
